news.headline: US September CPI due today 18:00 IST; headline seen 0.6% m/m (3.6% y/y), core 0.2% (2.5%)
news.summary: Energy lifts headline while core is expected to cool. A hot core would cement a December hike and lift real yields; a soft core would support gold. The day's dominant event.

news.headline: Fed's Williams: one more hike appropriate this year, none needed in 2027
news.summary: NY Fed chief sees disinflationary forces, AI and energy the main pressures; 2Y yields first fell, then recovered. Confirms the December hike path but caps the cycle.

news.headline: Rupee jumps 42 paise to 95.36 on new RBI steps; strongest since September
news.summary: RBI opened a dedicated dollar window for oil companies and raised costs of speculative hedges; dollar weakness and lower crude helped. Rupee touched 94.96 intraday. OCBC doubts a sustained reversal.

news.headline: Markets price ~88% chance of a December Fed hike; October hike odds up to ~20-23%
news.summary: FedWatch October hold slipped to ~77% from ~83%; swaps show ~90% for December. Rate pricing remains the main headwind for gold.

news.headline: Gold slips 0.2% to ~$4,161 in a second down day; silver -1.8%

news.headline: Kazakhstan central bank plans gold sales to cut gold to 75% of reserves

news.headline: Houthi-Saudi hostilities escalate; Saudi strikes Houthi oil depots near Sanaa
news.summary: Trump accused the Houthis of trying to lift oil before the midterms; US reportedly weighing joining the Saudi campaign. Houthi missile attacks on Saudi Arabia keep the Gulf risk premium high.

news.headline: Brent settles $105.69 (-0.9%), back above $106 in Asia; Hormuz supply risk persists

synthesis.overnight_summary: Gold fell for a second day on 13-Oct, slipping 0.2% to ~$4,161 as front-end yields rose on ~88% December hike pricing and oil stayed above $100 on Houthi-Saudi and Hormuz risk, even as the dollar eased from an 18-month high. Overnight it was flat (~$4,155-4,166) ahead of today's US CPI; NY Fed's Williams backed one more hike this year but none in 2027. In India the RBI's new steps lifted the rupee 42 paise to 95.36, so MCX Dec gold fell about Rs 1,000 to ~1,48,500. Overnight moves net out (COMEX +Rs 175, rupee Rs -183), so model fair open is ~Rs 148,492, essentially unchanged. Expect a quiet, rupee-led morning inside 1,48,000-1,49,000, with direction set by CPI at 18:00 IST.
